top_signals.title: Venezuela Aluminum Heads to US; Heeney Eyes Gold Deal
top_signals.summary: Venezuela is preparing to ship aluminum to the US under a deal with Mercuria Energy Group Ltd. and Heeney Capital, with the latter also planning to invest in a Venezuelan gold mine, accelerating a revival of commercial ties beyond oil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Corpus Christi LNG expansion makes facility the second-largest in the United States
top_signals.summary: On August 28, 2026, Cheniere Energy, Inc., completed its Corpus Christi Liquefaction Stage 3 Project (CCL Stage 3) in Texas, taking custody and control of the seventh and last liquefied natural gas (LNG) train in the project.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
